tools.name: lookup_rule
tools.description: Look up any of the 62 AEORank Technical SEO, AEO & GEO diagnostic rules (e.g. AEO-001..AEO-062, llms_txt, answer_first, entity_clarity) and 9-pillar weights.

tools.name: list_entity_sources
tools.description: Retrieve verified DR 70-98 self-serve entity & citation platforms (Wikidata, CERN Zenodo DOI, Hugging Face, GitHub, npm, PyPI, LinkedIn) for Knowledge Graph sameAs synchronization.

tools.name: search_knowledge_playbooks
tools.description: Search peer-reviewed Technical SEO, AEO, and GEO engineering guides from the AEORank Open Knowledge Hub (/learn and /tri-thuc).

tools.name: run_sandbox_audit
tools.description: Execute an instant zero-latency ($0) AEORank GEO-62 & Agentic Web 2026 diagnostic preview for a domain or URL.

tools.name: generate_agent_patch_pack
tools.description: Generate ready-to-deploy machine-readable patch files (/llms.txt, additive RFC 9309 robots.txt, XSS-safe Schema JSON-LD, agent-card.json, safe _headers, and .geo-answer-box Fan-Out HTML) plus a prompt-injection-hardened Coding Agent remediation prompt.
